"An AI chatbot can handle all your customer service so you don't have to."

This is a common expectation, and it usually leads to frustrated website visitors.

An AI chatbot is fantastic for answering repetitive FAQs instantly—pricing, shipping times, business hours, and basic features. It saves hours of manual replies.

However, it should never be a dead end. The moment a visitor asks a nuanced question or encounters an edge case, the system needs a clean, fast handoff to a human team member.

AI is an efficient front door, not a complete replacement for human judgment.
